messages:
Marta: Quick sync — pricing decision for mid-market bundles. Customer asks: want per-seat floor + burstable inference units. Do we go per-seat with included RU (request units) or committed RU with seat add-on? Need launch criteria and what to table for MVP.

Luke: I'd lean per-seat with RU bundle. Simpler for sales, predictable for customers. Seat = base price. Add-on RU for heavy tail.

Priya: From infra — burstable RU means we need token accounting across dedicated pools, and rate-limits per customer. Implementable but adds tracking + throttling work. ETA ~3 sprints for infra metrics and metering.

Jin: Sales feedback: big mid-market customers prefer one invoice line (seat + overage) vs separate RU SKUs. They also ask for soft caps and a 30-day grace for overages. @Legal any red flags?

Legal: Soft caps + grace ok but contract language must clearly state how overage rates apply and how we handle unexpected spikes. Need definitions for "burst" and metrics source (billing window).

Ben: Finance — unit economics: per-seat with included RU is better for ARR predictability. But embedded RU sizing matters a lot. Proposal A: seat $200/mo + 10M RU included, overage $0.002/RU. Proposal B: committed RU tiers + seat at $120/mo.

Ana: Customer use case: marketing automation with unpredictable spikes around campaigns. They want a short-term burst pool they can enable for 24-72h. Prefer toggle in Console and automatic billing. UX needs clear telemetry.

Marta: Good. Tradeoffs: A simplifies sales; B gives customers control and saves us tail cost. Need launch criteria: 1) billing accuracy within 0.5% for test tenants, 2) Console toggle + telemetry, 3) contract language template + overage tests, 4) legal signoff.

Priya: For 1) we can run a billing sim using synthetic traffic. I'll allocate an env and script. For 2) UI is ~1 sprint if back-end metering done. For 3) Legal + Finance to confirm wording.

Jin: Can we offer pilot customers a capped burst at discounted overage to reduce churn? e.g., first 48h at 50% overage rate.

Ben: We can carve that as a promo SKU. Need guardrails so it doesn't become permanent entitlement.

Legal: If we offer discounted pilot burst, include explicit term expiration and a usage report requirement. Also add a clause that we can revoke burst access for abuse.

Marta: Action items:
- Priya: bill sim env + estimate time (due EOW)
- Luke/Jin: sales messaging and pilot offer draft (due Tue)
- Ben: model unit economics for A/B proposals (due Wed)
- Legal: contract snippets for burst + overage (due Thu)
- Ana: UX sketch for burst toggle + telemetry (sync Fri)

Marta: Quick table draft for discussion:

Option A: Seat-first
 - Seat: $200/mo
 - Included: 10M RU
 - Overage: $0.002/RU
 - Pilot burst: 48h at 50% overage

Option B: RU-first
 - Seat: $120/mo
 - Committed RU tiers: 5M/15M/50M
 - Overage higher but predictable

Priya: One technical note: define RU precisely (tokens vs requests). For LLM heavy calls RU should be token-weighted. That affects pricing math.

Marta: Good call. We'll standardize RU = normalized token units (NTU) where NTU = tokens * model multiplier. Add to spec.

Jin: I'm ok to present Option A to pilot customers as it matches ask. We should keep Option B in docs as an alternative for heavy users.

Marta: Thanks all. I'll consolidate and create a roadmap ticket with launch criteria and owners. :thumbsup:
